necessary_context.content: K arms; losses ell_t in [0,1]^K; only ell_t,I_t is observed and suffered. Section 2 allows losses to depend on previous actions I_1,...,I_(t-1) and the adversary's internal randomness.
necessary_context.name: Adversarial bandit model

necessary_context.content: Rbar_T = E[sum_t ell_t,I_t] - min_i E[sum_t ell_t,i]. A comparator i*_T minimizes expected cumulative loss. Expectations include algorithm and environment randomness. For deterministic oblivious losses this equals expected hindsight regret; such equality is not asserted for adaptive adversaries.
necessary_context.name: Pseudo-regret and comparator

necessary_context.content: Algorithm 1, IW estimator, alpha=1/2, xi_i=1, eta_t=2/sqrt(t); Psi(w)=-4 sum_i sqrt(w_i)+2 sum_i w_i and Psi_t=Psi/eta_t on the probability simplex.
necessary_context.locator: PDF p.7 Algorithm 1 and (IW); p.8 §3.2; p.9 Theorem 1
necessary_context.name: Selected symmetric half-Tsallis IW specification
